summary: This clinical trial compares how two different drugs, Xuezhikang and atorvastatin, affect blood sugar and fat levels in patients. The study focuses on adults who have abnormal fat levels in their blood and a prediabetic state where blood sugar is higher than normal but not yet in the diabetic range. Researchers are looking at 398 participants in a Phase 4 study sponsored by Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital. The study is currently Recruiting.
